events.text: One tagging gap in `o2_runner.py`: a shape mismatch makes `maxdiff` return `float("inf")`, which the threshold check turns into a plain `FWD_MISMATCH` or `GRAD_MISMATCH` with `maxdiff=inf` in the note — same status a real value divergence gets, so the two are indistinguishable in `sweep_log.csv`. Tagging shape mismatches explicitly before the value compare:

events.diff:
wf, wg = 0.0, 0.0
       for k, (a, b) in pairs.items():
         if a is None or b is None: continue
+        if a.shape != b.shape:
+          status, note = "SHAPE_MISMATCH", f"{k} {a.shape} vs {b.shape}"; break
         d = maxdiff(a, b)
         at, rt = (ATOL_F, RTOL_F) if k == "fwd" else (ATOL_G, RTOL_G)
         if k == "fwd": wf = d
         else: wg = d
         if d > at + rt * float(np.abs(b.astype(np.float64)).max()):
           status = "FWD_MISMATCH" if k == "fwd" else "GRAD_MISMATCH"; note = f"{k} maxdiff={d:.3e}"; break
